reason: Source audit showed no exact-name matches because GloNAF Species=Genus_epithet; canonical alias gives 1118/2147 focal HOSTS host names. Subsequent strict prevalence-binned nonhost null was impossible: among 284 regions prevalence bin 201-284 there are 32 more documented host source taxa than alternative uncatalogued plants.
primary_output: all documented focal HOSTS candidate host-Jaccard partial correlation controlling non-documented alien plant Jaccard and same geography/climate/native/current WCVP, WITHOUT a strictly prevalence-matched null
separate overlap-only documented host correlation removing WHOLE bins where at least one distinct matched non-documented plant cannot be sampled per focal host, not choosing host species by results
199 draw matched pseudohost taxa with same source-coverage prevalence classes, no replacement within each draw
host_normalization: GloNAF Species uses Genus_species; canonical genus+species alias maps onto original source bit indices, preserving raw floristic identities and region data; HOSTS original genus+species names are fixed
supported_bin_rule: retain all documented host source raw taxon bit IDs in bin if non-documented GloNAF source taxon pool in same bin has at least as many distinct IDs; otherwise remove ENTIRE prevalence bin, deterministic response-blind decision
source_region_endpoints: 284 same official TDWG WGSRPD3 regions and associated 40171 resource beta pairs; bin frequencies count source plant taxa presence across these same 284 regions
plant_both_empty_behavior: observed host Jaccard only among pairs where at least one documented host; null pseudohost both-empty treated 0 and missing fraction audited
controls: log geography, same WGSRPD1, temperature/aridity differences, native plant/resource Jaccard, log min/max native plant richness, general WCVP flora beta delta, colonial shared exposure, log min/max all GloNAF plant richness and not-documented GloNAF plant Jaccard
caution: Cannot compare all-host observed and common-support observed as if same support; explicitly report pairs/host taxa attrition.
Uncatalogued GloNAF taxa are not proven biological nonhosts.
Common support exclusion of a highly prevalent bin limits generality; high-prevalence hosts may dominate real resource reorganization.
Recorded 2001+ host list and GloNAF all contemporary, not colonial time sequence.
199 matched sample draws are source-level control, not causal randomized biological experiments.
